The record shows no traffic justification on the replaced part of the recommended route at trip time: there are no speed band records at all (F15), the only traffic event the record treats as on the optimal route is the PIE vehicle fire at F16, and the driver never told the rider of it (F12, F13); F16 only decides whether a driver violation is recorded under RD-4, it does not exempt the segment from refund.
